svg.title: Timeline editing area
svg.desc: Timeline editing area with toolbar, tracks, blade, trim and marquee selection. Clip Placement defines shared valid, snapped, incompatible, locked and overlapping states for both moving existing clips and dropping assets. Track Header documents header controls and states. Locked Track shows the default and locked track look.
svg.text: One open timeline. Toolbar, ruler and tracks share one playhead.
Until a timeline file is opened
Create or select a timeline to begin editing
Accent marks a track that is locked, hidden or muted

g.text: Blade tool active. The red blade guide follows the pointer; a click splits clips at the blade guide.
Hovering a clip edge highlights its trim handle
Drag on empty space to select clips inside the box
One placement preview for dragging an asset or moving an existing clip. The destination determines its state.
Compatible, unlocked track with enough room for the clip.
Valid placement aligned to a clip edge. Blue guide marks the snap.
The clip type does not match the destination track.
Matching media type, but the destination track is locked.
The proposed position collides with an existing clip.
Valid: amber ghost, drag cursor, release to place.
Rejected: red hatching, blocked cursor and a reason.
Releasing a rejected placement makes no change.
Update immediately when the destination changes.
When moving, dim the original until release.
Cancel restores it. Asset drops have no original to dim.
Kind badge and name, then reorder and delete. State toggles below.
Locking a track covers its header and lane with neutral diagonal stripes. Clips keep their color.
Unlocked: the track looks and behaves normally
Stripes over the lane, header and clips; lock toggle turns amber
Stripes are neutral white. Red hatching stays reserved for rejected placements.
Clip colors, borders and labels are unchanged; only the stripes and the lock toggle change.
Selection shortcuts skip a locked track, and the blade never splits its clips.
Dropping or moving a clip onto a locked track is rejected with “Track is locked”.
